format.gaza2026Electronic: The 2026 Gaza cohort uses 40 four-choice, one-correct-answer MCQs in 60 minutes according to a secondary report quoting the Ministry notice; the Ministry launch page confirms the electronic Gaza cycle. The larger archive lesson is enrichment for coverage, not a simulation of the exact 40-item paper.

questionLedger: The active bank contains 798 stable question IDs: 714 single-choice MCQs and 84 exam-question flashcards. The original Gaza-pack items remain in source order; the answer-key-backed 800-question collection contributes 596 cleanly transcribed active MCQs after page-break repairs, with one ambiguous neurodegeneration item held in the source archive, and the 2023 Ministry classification booklet contributes 40 written-response flashcards. Source pages and reviewed WebP crops are retained for audit. Items with unresolved or malformed source text remain visible in the archive rather than silently publishing a guessed answer.
